crossRefs.note: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on…
There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels…
His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

crossRefs.note: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
crossRefs.keyword: his quiver full of them. Heb. filled his quiver with them.they shall

crossRefs.note: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

translations.web: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
translations.bsb: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
translations.kjv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
translations.asv: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate. Psalm 128 A Song of Ascents.
